attributes.name: Lend Mythic Path
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to allow a character at your location to use a power on your mythic path card.

Discard this card and expend a mythic charge to use a power on another character's mythic path card.

After playing this card, if you do not have the either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane 14 or Divine 16 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
